title: ServerCapabilities
description: The behavior surface a Bugzilla server exposes, as emitted by `bzr server capabilities --json`. Always-populated fields are derivable from a stock anonymous server; nullable fields are reported as null when undetermined.

api_modes.description: Transports the server supports: any of `rest`, `xmlrpc`.

auth_modes.description: Auth mechanisms the server accepts. `api_key` requires a REST surface; a pure XML-RPC server reports none.

max_attachment_size.description: Maximum attachment size in bytes, normalized from Bugzilla's kilobyte `maxattachmentsize` parameter. Null when undetermined (the parameter is admin-gated; only fetched when a credential is present).

status_transitions.description: Per-status allowed transitions, reused from the `field list status` data path.

flag_types.description: Available flag types. Null means undetermined by bzr (no anonymous server-wide data path exists yet), not that none are configured.

supports_comments.description: Transport-capability flag: whether the server's REST surface exposes comments. Derived, not probed.

supports_attachments.description: Transport-capability flag: whether the server's REST surface exposes attachments. Derived, not probed.

supports_history.description: Transport-capability flag: whether the server's REST surface exposes history. Derived, not probed.

supports_flag_requests.description: Transport-capability flag: whether the flag-update endpoint exists. Does not assert that any flag types are configured, so it may be true while flag_types is null.
